_comment: The LLMInferenceServiceConfig presets installed in the RHOAI applications namespace, which spec.baseRefs resolve against (mock/research/models-maas.md section 1: 23 presets named v3-6-0-kserve-config-llm-*; the list here is the subset the research names, the accelerator variants are left out). A baseRef outside this list is accepted by the API server and fails later with PresetsCombined=False/ConfigNotFound, as on the hub. Names are versioned by RHOAI release (open question 10), so they live in a fixture rather than in code.
